title: Bayesian Formulation of Acousto-Electric Tomography and Quantified Uncertainty in Limited View
summary: Acousto-electric tomography (AET) is a hybrid imaging modality that combines electrical impedance tomography with focused ultrasound perturbations to obtain interior power density measurements, which provide additional information that can enhance the stability of conductivity reconstruction. In this work, we study the AET inverse problem within a Bayesian framework and compare statistical reconstruction with analytical approaches.
